outcome: Let one Work Owner continue the same governed Essays work through desktop, CLI, and explicitly authorized remote clients while agents and supervised browsers contribute proposals and evidence without acquiring authority over accepted prose or external effects.
scope: Own the product meaning for a durable local-first Essays agent runtime, including client continuity, command and revision semantics, proposal custody, browser-action authorization, evidence capture, recovery, and replaceable local or remote access; implementation technology remains outside this capability.
exclusions: selecting or admitting a Rust, WebAssembly, desktop, database, browser, or transport implementation
allowing an agent, browser, transport, database, or client to accept prose or create editorial authority
treating local, loopback, or remote connectivity as trusted by location alone
handling credentials, bypassing site controls, escaping a sandbox, or performing an unapproved external effect
claiming performance, cross-platform parity, browser-control completeness, implementation conformance, product value, publication, release, or production readiness
